Lina: Noticed host CPU p95 up ~22% on traffic with many short prompts after last selector change. Posting quick traces.
Seth: flame: http://perf.red/fg/5990001111 shows stacks in normalize_before_tokenize() and http2_small_write().
Ravi: KV cache hit for short prefixes dropped 96% -> 84%. Looks like normalization changes changed key canonicalization.
Lina: Repro: 100k 48-byte prompts -> tokenize init and small write spam.
Seth: Quick fix candidates: defer normalization for payloads <128B, enable http2 writev coalescing, add tokenizer object pool.
Ravi: Also add kernel hint for seq_len<=12 to avoid kernel thrash and cold GPU cache.
DeployBot: deploy started: canary-5990 -> 2 hosts.
Lina: Plan: Seth pushes canary with normalization-after-tokenize flag + telemetry (kvcache.hit, token.init.lat). Ravi will run distributed sim. Lina will draft rollback steps.
Seth: Will post results in ~6h.
Ravi: Noted.
Lina: Thanks everyone.
